systems.name: 6.1 Playtesting & Balance
systems.notes: Full playthroughs by external testers. Adjust difficulty, ammo/health placement, and enemy counts. Ensure the sanity economy is fair.
tasks: Recruit testers and distribute builds
Collect feedback on difficulty and pacing
Tune enemy HP, damage, and resource drops
Balance sanity drain vs. restoration opportunities

systems.name: 6.2 Bug Fixing & Map Issues
systems.notes: Run audit protocol on all maps. Fix geometry errors, missing textures, stuck monsters, and script logic bugs.
tasks: Automated audit scan on all maps
Resolve all Error and Warning items
Fix collision and navigation mesh issues
Debug script logic and branching

systems.name: 6.3 Performance Optimization
systems.notes: Optimize draw calls, texture memory, and monster AI to ensure smooth 35fps on target hardware (GZDoom, Freedoom baseline).
tasks: Profile map performance with Visplane Explorer
Reduce texture memory usage and palettize
Limit monster count and active AI radius
Test on minimum spec hardware

systems.name: 6.4 Accessibility Options
systems.notes: Add colorblind mode, subtitle toggle, control remapping, and reduced-flash option.
tasks: Implement high-contrast HUD mode
Add subtitle support for all voice lines
Allow key rebinding via menu
Reduce screen flash intensity option

systems.name: 6.5 SRP Self-Test & Calibration
systems.notes: Run SRP's synthetic test maps (test-box, light-gradient) to validate the audit system. Calibrate thresholds based on final content.
tasks: Generate synthetic maps for SRP validation
Run full SRP cycle and review confidence scores
Adjust audit thresholds if needed
Finalise RuleSetHash and archive SRP report
